cards.title: Broad rebound; AI still on trial
cards.question: Was Nov 9 a regime turn or relief from oil?
cards.selfCheck: FACT: Nov 9 S&P +2.3%, Nasdaq +2.7%, IWM +3.1% as Brent fell 5.8%; NVDA fell 4.3%. 7d AI drawdown persists; Oct peak and Aug oil/rate stress frame 30/90d. TEST: earnings revisions, credit and breadth over weeks.
cards.prompt: Compare Reuters Nov 6 AI correction with AP Nov 9 rebound. https://apnews.com/article/d938f8e6ff42b3706e1d36e6245ec56b

cards.title: Small caps lead; chips diverge
cards.question: Is risk appetite broadening without NVIDIA?
cards.selfCheck: FACT: Nov 9 Russell +3.1% versus S&P +2.3%; NVDA -4.3%. WATCH RSP/SPY, IWM, XBI, SOXX/XSD, credit spreads and 10Y (~4.87%). REJECT broadening if breadth narrows or spreads widen.
cards.prompt: Explain why broad participation and falling oil may matter more than a single AI leader. Source AP Nov 9 https://apnews.com/article/f7ec9680fc858e3c2505913e7b3a54e2

cards.title: Demand is not deployment
cards.question: Which AI suppliers get paid if data centers are delayed?
cards.selfCheck: FACT: Nov 9 brokers disputed severe regulatory risk; some expect projects to shift 2028→2029, not vanish. HYPOTHESIS: MU, optical and power-efficiency suppliers remain resilient. REJECT if orders, utilization or margins weaken.
cards.prompt: Contrast durable AI chip demand with construction timing, permitting and capex returns. Reuters Nov 9 https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/wall-st-brokerages-say-ai-selloff-overdone-downplay-democrat-regulation-risks-2026-11-09/

cards.title: Rubin's 2027 payoff is pending
cards.question: When do platform promises become cash-generating capacity?
cards.selfCheck: FACT: NVIDIA described next-gen computing and strong data-center sales Feb 25, 2026. HYPOTHESIS: 2027 deployments lift HBM, optics and power demand. CHECK: shipments, site power-on, utilization and cost/token; slippage rejects timing.
cards.prompt: Build a 2027 commissioning scorecard from NVIDIA Feb 25 2026 results and subsequent platform announcements. https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-2026/

cards.title: CPI meets the AI earnings test
cards.question: Will rates or forward orders dominate the next quarter?
cards.selfCheck: WINDOW: Nov 2026 inflation/AI earnings; Q1–Q2 2027 capex plans. BULL: cooling inflation + firm orders; BEAR: sticky rates + delays. Verify release times from primary calendars; watch NVDA, MU, MSFT and CRWV.
cards.prompt: Create scenario matrix for November 2026 inflation, AI earnings and 2027 capex guidance; distinguish confirmed dates from estimates.

cards.title: Test suppliers against builders
cards.question: Will MU/optical/semicap beat financed AI operators by Dec 9?
cards.selfCheck: HYPOTHESIS (Nov 9 close baseline): equal-weight supplier basket outperforms CRWV/NBIS-like builders by Dec 9. TEST weekly relative returns plus credit, order and earnings revisions. REJECT if no outperformance or supplier orders deteriorate.
cards.prompt: Construct falsifiable Nov 9–Dec 9 2026 relative return test; control for sector beta and single-name events.
